description: This is a unit test class for the ModifyFeatureProperty class, testing its behavior, constructors, JSON serialization/deserialization, and validation logic.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ModifyFeatureProperty, verifying creation, JSON serialization, equality, immutability, and validation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that instances of ModifyFeatureProperty are immutable and immutable objects used within are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correct implementation of hashCode and equals methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures creating an instance with null String thing ID throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Checks that passing null ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Checks that passing null feature ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPropertyJsonPointer
methods.description: Checks that passing null property JSON pointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPropertyValue
methods.description: Checks that passing null property value throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that toJson method produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithValidArguments
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with valid arguments succeeds.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithInvalidArguments
methods.description: Verifies that invalid JSON pointers cause JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating an instance from valid JSON string, expecting an exception on invalid key.

methods.name: createInstanceFromInvalidJsonValue
methods.description: Tests creating an instance from invalid JSON value, expecting JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithValidPropertyJsonObject
methods.description: Checks that creating an instance with a valid property JSON object succeeds.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonWithInvalidPropertyPath
methods.description: Creates an instance from JSON and verifies property values are correctly parsed.

methods.name: modifyTooLargeFeatureProperty
methods.description: Tests that creating a Property with a size exceeding limits throws ThingTooLargeException.
